title: Priyanka Chopra Jonas' Fiery First Look as Mandakini Unveiled in Rajamouli's Varanasi
excerpt: Released on the actress's birthday, the images reveal two striking looks from the RRR director's globe-trotting epic, due for worldwide release on April 7, 2027.
body:
• The makers of SS Rajamouli's Varanasi unveiled Priyanka Chopra Jonas' first look as the character Mandakini on her birthday, July 18.
  • Two images show contrasting looks — a fierce black corset ensemble and a traditional saree — hinting at a complex, action-driven character.
  • Varanasi stars Mahesh Babu, Priyanka Chopra Jonas, and Prithviraj Sukumaran, and is Rajamouli's first feature since the Oscar-winning RRR.
  • The film, described as a James Bond-meets-Indiana Jones epic, is set for a worldwide theatrical release in nearly 200 languages on April 7, 2027.

The team behind SS Rajamouli's highly anticipated epic Varanasi dropped two striking images of Priyanka Chopra Jonas as her character Mandakini on July 18, the actress's birthday, giving audiences their most detailed look yet at what may be the biggest Indian film production in history.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=-Qw7E8TF_8I

Two Looks, One Message: Don't Underestimate Her

"He called me for this movie, and it's this epic adventure around the world and in time."

"He called me for this movie, and it's this epic adventure around the world and in time."

"He called me for this movie, and it's this epic adventure around the world and in time."

The first image shows Chopra in a black corset-style ensemble, sporting a messy bun and dramatic charcoal eye makeup — exuding intensity and suggesting her character has a fierce, action-heavy dimension. The second offers a different register entirely, presenting her in more traditional attire.

https://www.instagram.com/p/Da6zwLXkjBZ/

Rajamouli captioned his post with characteristic economy: "Grace when she smiles. Fire when she doesn't. Mandakini." The line instantly became a talking point among fans, adding intrigue to a character the actress has been guarded about revealing.

"I have been working on it for about 14 months now. He called me for this movie, and it's this epic adventure around the world and in time. I do many amazing slow-motion jumps in it, and that's all I can say about it."

— Priyanka Chopra Jonas, on the Hey Jonas podcast

Rajamouli's Post-RRR Ambition

Varanasi is Rajamouli's first feature since RRR, the 2022 action film that earned near-universal critical acclaim, praise from Hollywood titans including Steven Spielberg and James Cameron, and the Oscar for Best Original Song — making it the first and only Indian film to win an Academy Award.

https://x.com/FortuneIndia/status/2079077373119721492

The new film reunites Rajamouli with composer MM Keeravani and brings together an unprecedented cross-industry cast: Telugu superstar Mahesh Babu, global icon Priyanka Chopra Jonas, and Malayalam powerhouse Prithviraj Sukumaran, who plays the villain Kumbha — described as "sinister and ruthless" and depicted in a high-tech wheelchair.

The production has been described as the most expensive in Indian cinema history, with a globe-trotting scope inspired by the James Bond and Indiana Jones franchises.

Chopra's Return to Indian Cinema

For the Indian diaspora, the film represents Priyanka Chopra Jonas' return to Indian cinema after nearly seven years focused on Hollywood and global brand-building. Her involvement in a Rajamouli production — the director who put Indian cinema on the global awards map — has generated extraordinary anticipation across both domestic and international audiences.

Varanasi is set for a worldwide theatrical release on April 7, 2027, in nearly 200 languages. Mahesh Babu's first look, unveiled on his 50th birthday, showed a rugged figure adorned with a rudraksh mala and trishul pendant, hinting at mythological elements woven into the adventure narrative.
